change: Authenticated optional VAP3 endpoint feedback for non-silent decoder concealment; source/video reductions consume each fresh witness once, separately from packet loss and decoded discard.

feedback.sampling: Receiver-worker cumulative concealed_samples minus silent_concealed_samples, bound to actual decoder origin and target SSRC. First/new/unknown/gapped samples establish a baseline; no historical event.
feedback.freshness: Samples and locally detected events expire after 3 seconds before encoding; sender-local witness expires after 15 seconds. Monotonic origin/sequence/counter rejects replay. Detection time is not exact PCM concealment time or a cross-host clock.
feedback.cadence: Event-triggered supplemental empty RR + optional APPs, at most once per second per peer; regular audio RTCP also carries VAP3. No invented RTT/loss report blocks, video RTCP changes or external C ABI change.
feedback.source_policy: New witness restrains local competing sources and video. Room concealment alone cannot authorize longer audio packets; mute consumes event high water.
feedback.compatibility: VAP1/VAP2 unchanged; optional VAP3 is ignored by older endpoints. All feedback remains inside authenticated encrypted media channels.
